title: Chapter 636
paragraphs: Chapter 636
Episode 163. Return to the Clan (5)
The Garden of Swords, which had been shining with the sun and blue flame, darkened in an instant.
The unique deformed darkness brought about by chaos, Jin narrowed his eyebrows and looked at the blackened sky and the Garden of Swords.
There were red eyes gleaming everywhere. All were the gazes of the knights confronting Jin.
'The energy the knights exude becomes stronger as the darkness deepens... It must be the result of the prophet amplifying the chaos that was scattered throughout the Garden of Swords.'
He could not see the prophet and Rosa who had been in front of him. As if they had never been there in the first place.
Jin guessed that the amplification of the spirit energy was due to the use of some method by the two. That is, the prophet must have used Rosa's power as a medium to perform a trick.
'Or did the acting clan leader move to defend against external attacks?'
Kinzelo and Zipfel.
Jin was still confident that the two forces were watching the state of this fight and preparing for a total attack.
'If so, it's a valid judgment, but they will have no choice but to regret not holding me back any longer.'
Whether it was for defending against external attacks, or for some other reason.
Jin was confident that he would make Rosa regret leaving him behind for a long time.
And also all the choices she has made so far.
New knights were constantly appearing from somewhere.
Like bugs lurking in the darkness and squirming out at the sight of food, not knowing that the food contained a lethal poison.
Already their number was roughly over a thousand, and if they continued to multiply at this rate, it would reach ten thousand within an hour.
Every single one of these knights had a power level of 8 stars or more.
'But they're just battle dolls without a proper rank to match their power.'
To Jin, they felt no different from the monsters of the Mitra desert he faced on the first day of his return to the clan.
Of course, it was by Jin's standards. The chaos-infused knights certainly had enough combat power to wipe out an average kingdom in a day or two.
'The only ones I should be wary of are a few real players among them. Only the traitors who did not lose their rank despite being tainted by chaos.'
Huaaaaaah...!
The flames of anger grew deeper.
"How could you not understand that the direction of the clan is not decadence, degeneration, and evil, no matter how far you've gone..."
For a moment, the blue flame concealed Jin's location. The dark sword energies that lost their target vainly hammered against the barrier of the blue flame.
Runcandel's Fifth Secret Technique
Lightspeed Piercing - King
Five streams of light-speed piercing that poured out simultaneously tore the battlefield apart.
The chests of the knights who stood at the forefront were pierced with tiny holes, and the aftermath that spread out behind them successively erased chunks of chaos.
Before the knights could react and refill the collapsed lines, Jin was already at the point where the light-speed thrust that had spread in the middle had reached.
That location was where those, including the Tona brothers, who had been resisting the chaos until the end, were standing.
As soon as Jin took his position, the knights who were nearby, like dust swept away by the wind, were sliced by the Bradamante and disappeared.
"Ah, ah! Youngest brother!"
"Back, back!"
Tona brothers had mixed feelings when they saw Jin, who had come to open a path, but they had no choice but to urgently tell him to look behind.
That's because a black knight was swinging his sword from behind the younger brother.
Jin, without even looking in that direction, hugged the Tona brothers who were rushing to take the hit for him.
"Brothers, you've suffered a lot..."
The moment the brothers reunited, the black knight who was rushing from the rear could not reach Jin with his sword.
The flames engulfed him entirely.
Thunk, the helmet of the dead black knight fell to the ground, echoing a hollow sound.
"There's a lot I want to say, but let's get out of here first."
From the first moment he saw those trapped underground, Jin predicted that many of them would die here.
The Tona brothers screamed because of this. They said not to mind them and do what he planned to do.
Fortunately, the situation has changed.
'If there's no representative of the family, we can save many more knights than expected.'
Why did Rosa spare them? And why did she leave the spot without killing them?
Suddenly he had such questions.
The prophet simply explained it was the last consideration. If that's all, Jin felt he could never forgive her.
A person who dared to defile Runcandel couldn't possibly be considerate of Runcandel.
Of course, there were still many variables that could interfere with the task of saving the rebels.

Rosa could return to the battlefield where he is, and he couldn't predict how much the traitors would proliferate, and he could never be sure that there wasn't something among them that even Jin could hardly handle.
So, Jin had to evacuate them first.
"But it's unexpected that you stayed here, Elder Jorden."
Jorden Runcandel.
Jin made eye contact with him.
"......And judging by the atmosphere, it seems you were like the leader of the rebels."
While they were talking, the traitors couldn't approach Jin.
Jorden, looking at the flames protecting them and Jin alternately, let out a bitter laugh.
"I just recalled the essence of the family I had forgotten. Thanks to some crazy monster-like guy."
-Did you regain your confidence after losing everything? You dare to say such arrogant words.
-I just recalled the essence of the family I had forgotten.
Those were the same words Jorden had said in the past when Joshua had fallen and when he was facing Rosa.
"And originally, I wasn't the leader of the resistance, it was the fourth generation."
"Where is Brother Diphus? Where is Sister Mary?"
"I don't know. Whether they are alive or dead."
Diphus was still imprisoned in the underground dungeon, but the other resistance members didn't know that. He was being detained separately.
"…I'm sorry."
"It's not something you, the elder, should be sorry about. So, are all the survivors confirmed to be here right now?"
"Yes."
Like the others who resisted, Jorden's body clearly showed traces of the pain he had experienced in the underground prison.
Almost only bones remained, like a pallbearer, and the chaotic energy that had nibbled all over his body.
Nevertheless, Jin felt a transcendental quality from Jorden. A quality that never disappeared, no matter how weak the flesh became.
"It seems that your asceticism was successful, Elder."
"You don't seem to be anything compared to you."

"I can't be responsible for the escape until the end on my own. I wish I could, but it doesn't seem like the rebellion of the traitors will be just this much. When I break through, you, Elder, take responsibility and evacuate them. To Tikan."
"Phew... Interesting. We've always been in a hostile relationship, but you're saying you trust me?"
"No, I trust not Jorden, who was as vile as an old snake and the chairman of the Black Sword Association... but Jorden Runcandel, the knight of the family."
Jorden's pupils dilated.
"…I accept, the 12th generation."
Jin had not forgiven Jorden.
Jorden also knew this fact.
It's just that both of them ended up sharing the value of 'struggle', a Runcandel characteristic.
That was enough. As a reason to fight together for Runcandel, covering up the resentment.
"But, the 12th generation. As you just predicted, the power of Rosa Runcandel and the prophet is not all of this."
"Please tell me everything you know."
"The reason the traitors are now enhanced is because the chaos bound in the Sword Garden has been opened. We experienced the same situation when we were trapped in the underground prison."
At that time, the resistance fighters had put up quite a fight against the traitors soaked in chaos. Although not as much as Jin, they had cut down countless enhanced knights.
It was thanks to the likes of Jorden, Diphus, and Mary, who had reached a level of enlightenment after asceticism.
What completely despaired them that day was not the knights of chaos that resurrected endlessly and proliferated, nor the combat dolls that only had increased destructiveness.
"…Soon the knights who were interred in the mausoleum will appear."
"Do you mean the knights in the mausoleum?"
"What we directly confirmed were the former generations and the black knights. However, if I were a prophet, I would call more and stronger beings to face you…"
The moment Jorden finished speaking.

Suddenly, Jin executed a series of ten light-speed stabs, tidying up the surroundings. Furthermore, the energy of the fire that had been amplifying continued to grow to the point where its end could not be determined.
No matter how many ants there are, they cannot kill a lion.
Just as Jin saw the Knights of Chaos as no different from the monsters of the desert, Jorden saw the same.
"....Well, it seems there is no need to worry that much."
Jorden shrugged his shoulders.
He realized that Jin had so far used only about 30% of the power he possesses.
The reason why Jin cleared the surroundings was simple.
Among the traitors, a real hardliner had started to show his power in earnest.
The captain of the black knights, Stan.
He was slowly walking towards Jin.
"Go ahead, elder."
The resistors began to leave the Garden of Swords.
The land soaked in chaos was dizzying, but they used the blue path formed by the fire as a landmark.
Facing the swarming Knights of Chaos, the resistors didn't even need to swing their swords. The fire that surrounded them like a barrier was protecting them.
Their escape would only begin in earnest once they exited the domain of the fire.
"You seem to have no intention of attacking them, former Runcandel black knight captain Stan. You could inflict substantial damage to my fire. Is it something like your last bit of conscience?"
Stan did not respond, but just glared at Jin.
From him, a massive aura and chaos were being released.
"No, former 12th generation Jin Runcandel. I decided that not a single inch of my power should be wasted to confront you."
"I'm glad it wasn't a worthless conscience."
Jin stared into Stan's red eyes for a moment.
The black knight captain of Runcandel, who was a benefactor of life and fought alongside him in the Sword Emperor's Palace, was now his enemy, standing in his way.
"Fully concentrating on me is undoubtedly a wise choice. It's regrettable, though, that with such judgement, you didn't resist Rosa Runcandel's wickedness."

"The justification of striving for the survival of the family is eventually up to the last one standing. You're not yet qualified to judge whether Lady Rosa was wrong. Likewise, I'm not yet confident that you are wrong. That's a question that can only be settled after you die."
"I didn't know you were talented not only with a sword but also in talking nonsense....."
Just as Jin was about to charge at Stan.
Jin could sense another big shot appearing from behind.
[Black knight captain, I see why you've been waiting for me. For a moment, I thought that man was the current lord, Chiron Runcandel.]
Looking back, he was a knight Jin had never seen before, a figure who had just emerged from the tomb.
